headline: Fixture River Keeps Running
lines: The river now runs past the claim's edge.
The old bank markers still hold true.

headline: Fixture Board Turns Pages
lines: The tavern board gives each claim room.
Locked pages wait for earned news.

headline: Fixture School Bell Rings
lines: The schoolhouse chart points from chalk to field.
Every mark has a matching tool.

headline: Fixture Ledger Opens
lines: The claim book keeps only what the town has met.
Neighbors have their own small say.
